conviction_note: This is the first time the market sees FY26 (12 months to 31 Oct 2026). The guide is PBT GBP69-74m and consensus sits at its low end (69.8). I found nothing unpriced that decides the print. One negative lean: the first FY27 commentary lands against a +12% FY27 PBT consensus, with French consumer confidence at a 13-year low in October. It is a macro-to-company inference and the stock is already down 15.7% over 20 days. It is offset by guide arithmetic that sets the H2 bar low and by a moderate 2.98% aggregated short. So p_up 46 on abs 8.0 (new numbers, 2-analyst name, history tails of -26.7% and +9.3%) gives -0.64. The findings sum to -1.2. The two agree in sign; the scaled number is about half the sum because the run-up has already absorbed part of the macro read.

findings.finding: The release carries the first FY27 outlook against a FY27 consensus of PBT GBP78.2m (+12% on FY26e 69.8). INSEE's French household confidence fell 5 points to 80 in October 2026, the last month of ME Group's FY26 and the lowest since June 2013. France is the group's largest and most profitable market, and the company itself blamed its June profit warning on weaker French consumer confidence.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Nov 2025 year-end update ('sales growth underwhelms', qualitative outlook) fell 7.7%. The June 2026 warning blamed on French consumer confidence fell 26.7%. The July 2026 reiteration of guidance rose 9.3%.
findings.original_quote: En octobre 2026, la confiance des ménages se dégrade fortement. À 80, l'indicateur qui la synthétise baisse de cinq points et atteint son niveau le plus bas depuis juin 2013 (INSEE, French). Company link: 'The Board believes this is largely attributable to a shift in consumer spending patterns driven by lower consumer confidence' (RNS 1 Jun 2026)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The stock is down 15.7% over 20 days and 13.4% over 60, near its 52-week low on about 7.5x FY26e P/E. But the Edison consensus still carries +12% FY27 PBT growth, and a 2-analyst name may not have revised for an October data point. If this were fully priced, published FY27 estimates would have been cut before the update, and I could not find that they were.
findings.independence: Same direction, different source: the company's own 1 June 2026 attribution of the April softening to French consumer confidence (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/me-group-international--megp/trading-update/9593255). The Edison FY27e 78.2 bar is https://www.edisongroup.com/research/recovery-on-track-after-aprils-setback/BM-3683/

findings.finding: The FY26 guide sets a low H2 bar. FY25 PBT was GBP78.2m with H1 FY25 at GBP34.0m, so H2 FY25 was GBP44.2m. With H1 FY26 at GBP32.7m, the GBP69-74m guide needs only GBP36.3-41.3m in H2 FY26 (-7% to -18% y/y). Consensus 69.8 implies about GBP37.1m (-16%), against May vending revenue +11.1% and a positive June. That leaves room for an outturn in the lower half of the range or better.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The July 2026 interims, guide reiterated with strong May/June trading, rose 9.3%. In Nov 2025 PBT landed inside its own range but revenue growth underwhelmed, and the stock fell 7.7%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The outturn lands inside a range the company has repeated twice, so this sits near zero. What is visible is that consensus sits at the very bottom of the range while H2 arithmetic allows the middle; a market expecting a beat would not have sold the stock 15% into the update.
findings.independence: FY25 PBT GBP78.2m from the 2025 Annual Results RNS (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/me-group-international--megp/2025-annual-results/9485658). It cuts against finding 1 for the reported period only; finding 1 is about FY27, so the two can both be true.

findings.finding: The CFO has been on temporary medical leave since 21 Oct 2026, so the year-end update and its FY27 tone come from an interim CFO (27-year group Deputy Finance Director). That is a small risk to how credible and how conservative the outlook reads.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell 5.0% on the day of the announcement (119.4p to 113.4p, 2026-10-21, 1.5m shares).
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced on the 21 Oct reaction. The only residual is whether the release brings a further update, such as a permanent departure.

findings.finding: Between the 5 Nov ex-dividend date (3.60p) and the notice, the stock fell 6.2% on 9 Nov and 2.3% on 10 Nov on 3.2m and 5.1m shares (about 3-5x normal volume), while the FTSE 250 rose. No RNS, holding disclosure or news item explains it.
findings.why_not_priced: An unexplained drawdown is worth 0. It could be informed selling, a fund exit or index-related flow, and nothing in the filing record says which. Filed so a reader sees it, sized at zero.
findings.independence: FTSE 250 rose on 9-10 Nov (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/%5EFTMC?range=1mo&interval=1d), so the move was idiosyncratic. Investegate shows no MEGP RNS between 21 Oct and 11 Nov (https://www.investegate.co.uk/company/MEGP).

baseline_tension: The only directional finding (negative FY27 tone) cuts against the +2.49 priced lean (the short-squeeze and run-up components). It agrees with the -15.7% run-up, which suggests the market already expects caution, so p_up stays near 50 rather than going lower.

lessons_applied: 'Macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis' and 'a negative that agrees with the drawdown is priced': finding 1 cut from -1.8 to -1.5. Kept at that size because the company itself named French consumer confidence as the cause of its June warning.
'A finding that lands inside what the company already guided goes toward 0': finding 2 cut from +0.8 to +0.5.

'Size the move on what is new, not on reaction history' and 'the period is not pre-released, about 7.4% median': abs_move_pct raised from 7.5 to 8.0 for a 2-analyst name whose updates moved -26.7% and +9.3%.
'An unexplained drawdown is worth 0': the 9-10 Nov fall stays at 0 (it already was).
